title: Wilhelm Scream
blurb: The Wilhelm Scream — cinema's longest-running inside joke. Recorded in 1951 for Distant Drums, it took its name from Private Wilhelm, a character shot by an arrow in a 1953 western. Sound designer Ben Burtt found the original reel, used it in Star Wars, and turned an anonymous stock yell into a tradition: hundreds of films have since smuggled it in as a wink to anyone listening closely. Once you can hear it, you cannot stop. Use it for falls, explosions, and any demise that deserves to be theatrical rather than dignified.
origin: Recorded in 1951 for 'Distant Drums'; named after a character shot by an arrow in a 1953 western.
